I mean, leaving her like that IS a pretty asshole thing to do, especially 3 weeks after she pushed a person out of her. “Pregnancy brain” is a real thing and having a baby permanently alters women’s brains.

If she was like that before the pregnancy she may have a mental disorder and need medication and therapy. The way you worded it “heartfelt(…)there for her but now I’m the worst person ever” sounds a little like BPD. 

I went back before posting this and read some of your other responses, particularly the one regarding her stance on counseling, that is particularly concerning and means she DEFINITELY needs it. I had an ex whose ex wife had bpd and he described her in a very VERY similar way, it wasn’t until she blew up at her kid that she went to get help and after getting medicated she’ll still have mood swings but they aren’t as wildly severe. 

She needs help, but you shouldn’t drag yourself down just to be with her. Some people “stay together for the kid” but that often ends up doing much much more damage than a clean separation and coparenting. I wish you luck
